List the flags raised by a pipeline

Source: R/pipeline.R
flags.Rd

List the flags raised by a pipeline

Usage

flags(p, status = "open", level = NULL, stage = NULL)

Arguments

p

a pipeline from mv_pipeline().

status

which flags to show: "open" (the default), "all", or any of "acknowledged", "overridden" and "fixed".

level

optional levels to keep ("info", "review", "block").

stage

optional stages to keep ("intake", "calibration", "reporting").

Value

A tibble with one row per flag: id, stage, check, target (an item, a pair of items, a group, or the whole test), value (the statistic), rule (the threshold that fired), level, advice (what to do about it), status and note (the reason recorded with a decision).

Examples

# \donttest{
p <- add_responses(mv_pipeline(), certexam, items = 3:34, key = certexam_key)
flags(p)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 10
#>      id stage  check           target value      rule  level advice status note 
#>   <int> <chr>  <chr>           <chr>  <chr>      <chr> <chr> <chr>  <chr>  <chr>
#> 1     1 intake possible_miskey Q14    p = 0.18,… p < … block Check… open   ""   
flags(p, level = "block")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 10
#>      id stage  check           target value      rule  level advice status note 
#>   <int> <chr>  <chr>           <chr>  <chr>      <chr> <chr> <chr>  <chr>  <chr>
#> 1     1 intake possible_miskey Q14    p = 0.18,… p < … block Check… open   ""   
# }
